entities.name: Scattered Spider
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider is a cybercriminal group that targets large companies and their contracted information technology (IT) help desks.

entities.name: Social engineering
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors use multiple social engineering techniques—including push bombing—and subscriber identity module (SIM) swap attacks.

entities.name: MFA fatigue
entities.evidence: Sent repeated MFA notification prompts leading to employees pressing the "Accept" button (also known as MFA fatigue).

entities.name: SIM swap
entities.evidence: Convinced cellular carriers to transfer control of a targeted user’s phone number to a SIM card in their possession, gaining control over the phone and access to MFA prompts.

entities.name: Data exfiltration
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors have observably exfiltrated data [TA0010] after gaining access and threatened to release it without deploying ransomware.

entities.name: Fleetdeck.io
entities.evidence: Fleetdeck.io Enables remote monitoring and management of systems.

entities.name: Level.io
entities.evidence: Level.io Enables remote monitoring and management of systems.

entities.name: Mimikatz
entities.evidence: Mimikatz [S0002] Extracts credentials from a system.

entities.name: Ngrok
entities.evidence: Ngrok [S0508] Enables remote access to a local web server by tunneling over the internet.

entities.name: Pulseway
entities.evidence: Pulseway Enables remote monitoring and management of systems.

entities.name: Screenconnect
entities.evidence: Screenconnect Enables remote connections to network devices for management.

entities.name: Splashtop
entities.evidence: Splashtop Enables remote connections to network devices for management.

entities.name: Tactical.RMM
entities.evidence: Tactical.RMM Enables remote monitoring and management of systems.

entities.name: Tailscale
entities.evidence: Tailscale Provides virtual private networks (VPNs) to secure network communications.

entities.name: TeamViewer
entities.evidence: TeamViewer Enables remote connections to network devices for management.

entities.name: Teleport.sh
entities.evidence: Teleport.sh Enables remote access to a local system by tunneling over the internet.

entities.name: AnyDesk
entities.evidence: AnyDesk Enables remote access to network devices for management, bypassing security alerts due to AnyDesk being a legitimate application.

entities.name: AveMaria (also known as WarZone [S0670])
entities.evidence: AveMaria (also known as WarZone [S0670]) Enables remote access to a targeted organization’s systems.

entities.name: Raccoon Stealer [S1148]
entities.evidence: Raccoon Stealer [S1148] Steals information including login credentials [TA0006], browser history [T1217], cookies [T1539], and other data.

entities.name: VIDAR Stealer
entities.evidence: VIDAR Stealer Steals information including login credentials, browser history, cookies, and other data.

entities.name: RattyRAT
entities.evidence: RattyRAT Java-based remote access trojan, used for persistent, stealth access and internal reconnaissance.

entities.evidence: DragonForce Ransomware Infiltrates networks, encrypts data, and demands ransom.
